products.name: Ethiopia Guji Natural
products.short: Blueberry, Jasmine, Wild honey. Light roast from Ethiopia · Guji. Roasted to order and shipped within 24 hours.
products.long:
Ethiopia Guji Natural comes from Guji Zone, Oromia, grown by Shakiso smallholders at 2,100 m. The cherries are natural, dried on raised beds, which is where the blueberry and jasmine in the cup come from.

We roast it to a light profile in 12 kg batches on our Probat drum roaster, cupping every batch before it ships. Expect blueberry, jasmine and a finish of wild honey.

Each bag is packed in a recyclable, one-way-valve pouch the day it is roasted. For the best cup, brew within four weeks of the roast date printed on the label.

products.short: Variable-temperature gooseneck kettle with a precise pour spout and a 60-minute hold function.
